outcome.Summary: Rewrote Map in pool/pool.go (signature unchanged) with three fixes: (1) results are written into a preallocated out[i] slot, so order is always input order regardless of arrival order; (2) a stop channel is closed when ctx is cancelled or a call fails — the dispatcher stops handing out inputs, and the results channel is only closed after a WaitGroup confirms every worker exited, so Map always returns ctx.Err() promptly on cancellation and never leaks goroutines; (3) all error results are tracked and the *IndexError returned uses the lowest failing index, not the first arriving error. Added tests (order under 16 workers with shuffled completion times, cancellation returning context.Canceled within a timeout plus a NumGoroutine leak check, lowest-error-index over 10 iterations with a fast high-index failure arriving before a slow low-index one, error-stops-new-work stability, and empty input). Verified with go test -race -count=1 ./... (repeated, plus -count=5) — all pass.
